atlas.prompt: Production transparent sprite atlas for Monster Slam game UI. Reference images are approved skill-tree icons, style only, not layout to copy. Exactly EIGHT isolated pictograms in a precise FOUR-column TWO-row grid, landscape aspect 2:1. Equal square cells, centers at x=1/8,3/8,5/8,7/8; y=1/4,3/4. Each object fits within middle 64% of its cell, generous transparent gaps, no overlap. Transparent background genuinely alpha including holes, NO painted checkerboard. Style: polished chunky low-poly sculpted fantasy game inventory icons, tactile materials, simple strong silhouettes readable at 48px, gentle upper-left lighting, subtle bevel. These are SINGLE-USE MAGIC SPELL CHARMS: each object carries a soft inner magical glow in its own accent colour and two or three tiny sparkles kept tight to the object. NO medallion behind icons, no circles, no halo discs, no text, no labels, no numbers, no emoji look, no backing tiles, no floor shadow. Consistent size and three-quarter view. Row-major reading order, exact objects: (1) Drittes Auge: a single faceted violet gemstone set in a small bronze almond-shaped amulet, the gem cut so it looks like an open glowing eye with a bright pupil of light. One amulet, no chain. Clearly a jewel, NOT a natural eye with sclera and iris.; (2) Orakelblick: a clear crystal ball resting on a small three-clawed bronze stand, inside it a swirling violet-and-gold mist with a few star points. Larger and richer than a plain gem, it reads as the stronger seeing spell.; (3) Sumpf: a plump snail with a spiral shell, the shell glowing moss green from within, a short trail of glossy green slime behind it. Friendly, not disgusting. No mud puddle, no footprint.; (4) Schwere Luft: a dense rounded cloud of heavy dusky blue-grey fog, its underside drooping into thick hanging tendrils, with a small dark iron counterweight hanging from it on a short chain, as if the air itself is weighed down. No raindrops, no lightning.; (5) Frost: a cluster of three sharp translucent ice crystals growing from one base, the tallest in the middle, pale blue with white frosted edges and a cold inner light. No snowflake symbol, no snowman.; (6) Donnerschlag: a dark slate-blue storm cloud with ONE bold jagged lightning bolt striking down out of it diagonally, the bolt glowing electric blue-white with a white-hot core. The bolt dominates the icon. No rain.; (7) Lebensquell: a heart-shaped faceted ruby crystal with a tiny trickle of glowing clear spring water welling up from its top and running down one side, a few small green life sparkles. No bandage, no cross, no bottle.; (8) Eisenhaut: a compact riveted steel breastplate (cuirass) seen from the front three-quarter angle, polished silver-steel with a bright magical sheen sweeping across it. No shield, no helmet, no sword..
